name: Cookie Butter Cloud Latte
flavor_notes: Velvety spiced speculoos cookie butter cold foam layered over chilled espresso and sweet vanilla iced milk.
barista_note: Cookie butter is dense at room temp. Microwave it for 8–10 seconds before adding the heavy cream so the handheld frother emulsifies it into an airy cloud instead of leaving heavy clumps at the bottom.

variations.title: Lacey's Creamer Shortcut
variations.twist: Quick hack using Chobani Cookie Butter creamer and brown sugar instead of whipping cold foam from scratch.

variations.title: MainStMuse's Swirled Cup Latte
variations.twist: Drizzles melted Biscoff inside the glass and dissolves cookie butter directly into the hot instant espresso concentrate.

preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Big Trouble or Joe Coffee The Daily
preparations.roast_note: Caramel-forward, nutty medium roast that balances speculoos spices without overpowering the foam.

ingredients.item: Cometeer capsule, fully melted and chilled

steps: ## Phase 1: Cookie Butter Cloud Foam
In a small frothing cup, warm 1 tbsp cookie butter for 8–10 seconds to soften.
Add 2 tbsp heavy cream and 1 tbsp cold milk, then froth with a handheld frother for 20–30 seconds until thick and airy. Set aside.
## Phase 2: Iced Vanilla Latte & Assembly
Defrost the Cometeer capsule completely and chill before pouring.
Fill a serving glass with ice, add 2 tsp vanilla syrup and 4 oz cold whole milk, and stir gently.
Pour the chilled Cometeer extract directly over the iced milk.
Spoon the prepared cloud foam from Phase 1 over top and garnish with crushed Biscoff cookie crumbs.

preparations.roast_note: Toasted cereal and biscuit notes in Double Espresso Chiaro pair seamlessly with spiced speculoos.

ingredients.item: Nespresso Vertuo Double Espresso pod (Chiaro or Scuro)

steps: ## Phase 1: Cookie Butter Cloud Foam
In a small frothing cup, warm 1 tbsp cookie butter for 8–10 seconds to soften.
Add 2 tbsp heavy cream and 1 tbsp cold milk, then froth with a handheld frother until thick and velvety. Set aside.
## Phase 2: Iced Vanilla Latte & Assembly
Fill a serving glass with ice, then add 2 tsp vanilla syrup and 3 oz cold whole milk; stir gently.
Brew the Vertuo Double Espresso pod directly over ice in a separate cup to rapidly chill (or brew directly into the glass).
Pour the chilled espresso over the iced vanilla milk.
Crown with the prepared cloud foam from Phase 1 and sprinkle crushed Biscoff cookie crumbs on top.

preparations.tested_with: Nescafé Gold Espresso or Medaglia d'Oro
preparations.roast_note: A smooth, nutty medium instant roast lets the spiced speculoos and brown-sugar flavors shine.
steps: ## Phase 1: Cookie Butter Cloud Foam
In a small frothing cup, warm 1 tbsp cookie butter in the microwave for 8–10 seconds to soften.
Add 2 tbsp heavy cream and 1 tbsp cold milk to the warm cookie butter. Froth with a handheld milk frother for 20–30 seconds until a thick, airy 'cloud' foam forms. Set aside.
## Phase 2: Iced Vanilla Latte & Assembly
In a small cup, stir 1.5 tsp instant espresso into 2 oz hot water until completely dissolved.
Fill a serving glass with ice, then add 2 tsp vanilla syrup and 4 oz cold whole milk. Stir to blend.
Pour the dissolved espresso over the iced milk.
Spoon or pour the prepared cloud foam from Phase 1 over top, and finish with crushed Biscoff cookie crumbs.
